Defined in: [hotkey-recorder.ts:167](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/hotkeys/src/hotkey-recorder.ts#L167)

Options for recording up to `maxSteps` chords. A one-step recording commits
as a chord string; two or more steps commit as a sequence.

- `HotkeyRecorderBaseOptions`

### ignoreInputs?

```ts
optional ignoreInputs?: boolean;
```

Defined in: [hotkey-recorder.ts:134](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/hotkeys/src/hotkey-recorder.ts#L134)

Whether to ignore keyboard events from input-like elements (text inputs,
textarea, select, contenteditable) while recording. When true, typing in
inputs passes through normally (Escape still cancels). Defaults to true.

### recordTab?

```ts
optional recordTab?: boolean;
```

Defined in: [hotkey-recorder.ts:141](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/hotkeys/src/hotkey-recorder.ts#L141)

Whether to record Tab and Shift+Tab. By default they cancel recording and
move focus, so keyboard users can leave the recorder. Tab with Control,
Alt, or Meta isn't affected. When true, tell users that Escape cancels.
Default: false

#### Inherited from

```ts
HotkeyRecorderBaseOptions.recordTab
```
